# Darkroom

Generate media through a host-supplied provider, retain its exact output, and
retry saving without repeating inference. Your host owns identity, permission,
billing and destination access.

Use the root entry for the model catalog and settings. `server` composes the
service and portable SQL owner. `cloudflare` binds that owner to a SQLite
Durable Object and supplies Workers AI and Images adapters. `provenance` strips
private image metadata for downloads.
